SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.artist
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.format = 'commander'
  AND l.status = 'Legal'
  AND (c.power = '*' OR c.power IS NULL);

SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.artist
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE lower(l.format) = 'commander'
  AND lower(l.status) = 'legal'
  AND (
    c.power IS NULL
    OR trim(c.power) = ''
    OR c.power IN ('*', '—', '?')
  );

SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.artist
FROM cards c
WHERE (c.power IS NULL OR trim(c.power) = '' OR c.power IN ('*','—','?'))
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM legalities l
    WHERE l.uuid = c.uuid
      AND lower(l.format) = 'commander'
      AND lower(l.status) = 'legal'
);
